title: Free-threaded: pages freed by other threads are not returned while the owning thread is idle (and the default purge delay keeps them after it exits)
author: aryanj723
body_preview: ### Bug report  In the free-threaded build (`--disable-gil`), each thread allocates from its own mimalloc heaps. title: SequenceMatcher.get_grouped_opcodes() changes the result of later get_opcodes() calls
author: Broyojo
body_preview: ### Bug report  `SequenceMatcher.get_opcodes()` caches its result and returns the same list on every call. `get_grouped_opcodes()` takes that list and overwrites its first and last entries to trim the context, so after one call the matcher's opcodes no longer cover the whole input, and a later `get_grouped_opcodes()` with a larger `n` shows less context than it should. title: cmath.log(0, base) returns (-inf+nanj) instead of raising ValueError
author: Broyojo
body_preview: ### Bug report  `cmath.log(0)` raises `ValueError`, but `cmath.log(0, base)` returns a value such as `(-inf+nanj)` for most bases. In `cmath_log_impl`, the domain error from `c_log(z)` is stored in `errno`, and the second call `c_log(base)` resets `errno` to 0 before it is checked.  ```python import cmath, math  cmath.log(0)       # ValueError: math domain error cmath.log(0, 2)    # (-inf+nanj) cm...

title: `importlib.util.LazyLoader` deadlocks when two threads first-touch modules in an import cycle
author: djrobstep
body_preview: ### Bug report  `_LazyModule.__getattribute__` serialises the lazy load with a per-module `threading.RLock` (`loader_state['lock']`, added in gh-114763).
